questions.text: Will the S&P 500 close higher today than its previous close, per WSJ market data?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per the S&P 500 (SPX) official closing value on the WSJ Markets quote page, today's close > the prior session's close. Resolves at today's 4:00 PM ET market close — well before the 11:00 AM ET D+1 grace window.

questions.text: Will tonight's overnight low temperature in Central Park undercut the NWS forecast overnight low issued this morning, per NWS observations?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per the National Weather Service Central Park (KNYC) observed overnight low vs. the NWS forecast low issued this morning for tonight, observed < forecast. NWS posts the overnight low observation by early morning D+1, resolvable well before 11:00 AM ET.

questions.text: Will the #1 movie at the U.S. box office today be the same title that was #1 yesterday, per Box Office Mojo's daily chart?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per Box Office Mojo's daily domestic chart, today's #1 title matches yesterday's #1 title. Box Office Mojo posts today's daily estimates the same evening, well ahead of the 11:00 AM ET D+1 grace window.

questions.text: Will the lead headline on the NYTimes.com homepage tomorrow morning be a different story than today's lead headline, per nytimes.com?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per a same-time (7:00 AM ET) comparison of the lead headline on nytimes.com, tomorrow morning's top story differs from today's. Resolvable at 7:00 AM ET D+1, ahead of the 11:00 AM ET grace window.

questions.text: Will any MLB game scheduled for today be decided by 6 or more runs, per official MLB.com box scores?
questions.resolution_criteria: Per MLB.com's official box scores, at least one game scheduled for today ends with a final run differential of 6 or more. All scheduled games conclude by late evening ET, well ahead of the 11:00 AM ET D+1 grace window.
